name: Dialog
rows: Let us begin REBUILD: EDEN now.

Currently, the state of usable facilities in Eden is approaching a critical level.
If the Queen attacks once again with the same intensity, restoring the facilities may become impossible.
Our objective is to start over by collecting basic resources to rebuild Eden's facilities.
First, we need to construct a Power Plant and a Daily Supply Station.

Objective buildings completed.
Main objective system cleared.
Let's keep completing our main objectives and gradually expand the list of facilities that can be constructed.
Looks like the elevator construction's done.
Remember, without the elevator, electricity can't be supplied to the other floors, and the facilities won't operate properly.

Dorm 1 has been constructed. 
You can now deploy squads.
You can now dispatch squads on missions to collect materials needed for Eden's reconstruction or eliminate Raptures to obtain essential resources.
In addition to the Daily Supply Station and the Resource Collection Station, you can now gather resources through Dispatch Missions as well, so be sure to make full use of them.
The Equipment Production Facility has been constructed.
Use it to produce equipment for dispatch missions.

For now, it is capable of producing... baseball bats.
As Eden's reconstruction progresses, you'll eventually be able to produce equipment made from other materials.
To carry out dispatch missions more efficiently, try to produce equipment whenever resources allow.
Since you're getting the hang of dispatch missions...
Let's try using the Facility Upgrade feature.
This feature is only available in some facilities.
Some examples include the Resource Collection Station and Power Plant.
The efficiency may seem somewhat low given the resources consumed, but it's still beneficial in the long term. Use it whenever you can.

The Employment Management Office construction is complete.
You can now hire units like mecha Nikkes and robot assistants to help with the reconstruction.
Hired units come with attributes that can benefit Eden's facilities. Be sure to review a unit's details thoroughly before hiring them.

Hmm... Not bad. You're progressing at a decent pace.
You can start using Facility Assignment now.
Facility Assignment allows you to assign units to facilities, utilizing their beneficial effects to maximize the facilities' efficiency.
Some units' unique effects can only be activated when they are assigned to a facility.
Review each unit's effect, such as reducing power requirements or shortening production time, and assign them accordingly for more efficient operations.
Hmm... The reconstruction seems to be going smoothly.
You can also hire me as a unit and have me manage the facilities directly.
Now, let's try to work more efficiently.
There is an effect in Eden called Facility Synergy.
They are effects that activate when you build facilities according to specific conditions.

While most of these effects are similar to the unique effects that units possess,
Facility Synergy grants additional beneficial effects.
Keeping Facility Synergy in mind when placing facilities is also a great way to improve efficiency.
Hmm... It's not perfect yet, but we've nearly restored Eden to its pre-attack state.

What's left now are the Command Center and Upper Level Passage.
Rebuilding these two will require a lot of resources, so we'll need to stock up adequately.

Whew... I didn't think this would be possible with the ongoing battle, but it was completed faster than I expected.
This is great news.
Rearranging facilities to activate Facility Synergy effects, or completing unfinished side missions.
Now that the urgent issues have been dealt with, you're free to manage Eden as you wish.

rows.label: The Sorceress Who Walks with Death
